why: Esnault and Groechenig's 'The Grothendieck-Katz Conjecture for privileged local systems' (arXiv 2606.16873, June 2026) proves the conjecture for a new class of local systems in higher dimension via a proof avoiding middle convolution, settling a case while the general conjecture remains open. A separate March 2024 Movasati paper claiming a reformulation with stronger hypotheses was later withdrawn.
